page.overview:
What is Queens?

Queens is where Peter Parker, Aunt May, and Uncle Ben make Spider-Man's origin feel neighborhood-close within New York City.

Also known as: Queens NY, Forest Hills.

entity.description:
It is also primarily residential but not without its important manufacturing, distribution and transportation facilities as Queens is home to both John F. Kennedy and LaGuardia Airports. Manufacturers of paints, metals, textiles, and paper products are located here.

Like Brooklyn, the neighborhoods of Queens are diverse and distinct with large Hispanic neighborhoods such as Little Columbia and many African American areas. Other ethnic groups in the groups populating the neighborhoods of Queens include Irish, Italians, Jews, Chinese, and Koreans.

When Black Bolt confronted Thanos in hopes of preventing the Mad Titan's invasion of Earth in the search of his son, he unleashed a powerful attack that triggered a Terrigen Bomb and destroyed Attilan in the process. The resultant Terrigen Cloud released in New York City struck Queens and transformed Humans of Inhuman descent including The Exile.

In this reality, Peter Parker lived with his Aunt May for some time in a home in Queens.
